minutes.headline: Select Board recommended the FY2017 operating budget and other articles, then signed the 2016 town meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The board met early to go through the annual town meeting warrant articles, deciding which to recommend now and which to hold until Town Meeting. They also approved minutes, accepted a stormwater committee resignation and planned upcoming meetings. Public comment raised a Pleasant Street agenda item and the Green Communities task force.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to recommend approval of the FY2017 operating budget, article 15, at the amount in the warrant.
The board also voted to recommend the stabilization fund transfer (article 17) and article 19, the water department article.
Recommendations on the solid waste fund (article 18) and the inflow infiltration stabilization fund (article 21) were left for Town Meeting, pending numbers and a Sewer Commission report.
The board voted to make recommendations at Town Meeting on the zoning article and on article 44, the citizen petition on yard waste.
The chair will arrange for recommendations to appear in the printed warrant and invite the article 44 petitioners to explain costs before Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The operating budget and the funds behind it are decided at Town Meeting, so these recommendations show which warrant articles the board will back when residents vote on spending and taxes.
Article 44 on yard waste could change a town service, and the board has asked for its costs and budget impact to be explained before the vote.
watch_next: The April 12 board agenda, which is to include a May 3 meeting and an update on the Pleasant Street property.
Presentation by the article 44 petitioners, and the Sewer Commission report on article 21, before Town Meeting.
